scientific_issue: In max-valence-2 square-lattice chemistry, naturally occurring simple rings could be topologically closed and kinetically persistent; current WL cyclic fingerprint (exact=false) can alias nonisomorphic species-labeled rings. Quantify emergence, lifetime, and natural aliasing without changing ALife dynamics.

prediction.deterministic_counterexample: Two synthetic 4-member rings, with same 2 S0 + 2 S1 but sequences S0,S0,S1,S1 versus S0,S1,S0,S1, yield same original F: fingerprint but distinct exact cyclic canonical code.
prediction.geometry: With even 24x24 toroidal 4-neighbor grid, all cycles are even; any observed odd cycle signals a bug.
prediction.valence: A simple ring has all member degrees two; since all ring-forming species have max_bonds two, an intact ring cannot acquire external bonds without a bond breaking.
prediction.empirical: Natural cycles may or may not arise at tested densities; count all zero runs and avoid assuming a positive event.

world.initial_conditions: World.create of original M6 Config with only grid size, seed and species counts adjusted, zero bonds and random uniform placement; NO artificial scaffolds.

measurements.cycle: A connected component with N>=4, exactly N edges, every constituent degree=2; with max valence 2, this is a simple cycle (includes winding rings).
measurements.canonical_exact: For the cyclic ordered species sequence, minimal lexicographic rotation across both forward and reverse traversal; this is an exact isomorphism invariant for connected, degree-2, species-labeled cycles; separate from old F: signature and no edits to its historical definition.
measurements.alias: F: key maps to more than one exact cyclic canonical signature, first in the synthetic fixture and optionally in spontaneous run(s). Same F: does NOT mean same topology/sequence; count distinct aliases by true canonical code.
measurements.episode: Continuous observations of exactly the same material IDs and edge IDs making a cycle. Terminate at first recorded break BondEvent of any episode edge (even if reformed in same world tick) OR first absent/changed snapshot. A later reformation starts a NEW episode.
measurements.chain4_control: Continuous observation of the same four physical IDs and three bond IDs in a simple 4-member linear chain. Terminate at first break or any topology change, including attachment. Compare episode survival descriptively with 4-rings; groups are not randomized, cannot infer a causal topology effect.
measurements.ring_closure: A detected ring is 'from_snapshot_chain' if the immediately preceding tick had the same four IDs as one connected 4-chain; otherwise label unknown predecessor. Do not call closure autocatalysis.
measurements.runtime: Mark per-run event counts, distinct ring material sets, length composition by ring size, ring 4/chain 4 episodes and durations, WL collisions, example ID sets, and initial/final full hash + RNG.
measurements.energy: All worlds checked with World.check at t0 and t600; observer must never draw RNG.
measurements.no_birth: No particle births in these configurations; 'ring birth' means ring-forming reaction, not living organism birth.

analysis.primary: Number of naturally formed simple cycles and of 4-cycles per run/density; percentage of worlds with >=1 ring; count of different exact species cycles and actual WL alias collisions.
analysis.secondary: Observed lifetime distribution and right-censoring for continuous 4-cycle vs 4-chain episodes, closure from chain4, spontaneous 4-cycle ring formation and first bond break; event-based vs snapshot-based lifetimes clearly separated.
analysis.predefined_decision: If >=2 nonisomorphic naturally formed cycles share the same WL key, report confirmed natural fingerprint aliasing. Synthetic test aliasing alone is still a confirmed analytic limitation. If >=1 naturally formed ring episode survives >=50 consecutive observed ticks, report measured long-lived self-sealed structure, NOT replication. Null findings remain negative results and do not trigger configuration changes.
analysis.observational_limits: Nonrandomized cycle/chain comparison, no controlled causal selection, small 24x24 periodic world, densities differ slightly in species ratios, ring classification exact only for degree2 topology, no proof of inheritance.

integrity.cross_check: Recreate world without observer and require equal final full hash, RNG fingerprint/draws, total energy/dissipation and bond counters.
integrity.tests: Synthetic two four-cycle shapes must have identical F: key with exact=false and distinct canonical cyclic signature; a known six-member cycle must be rotation/reversal invariant; all observed cycle lengths even.
